title: wktest-promote: staging binary promotion
desc: Promotes wktest-core-*.exe staging build to bin/wkappbot-core.exe after mandatory smoke gate. The ONLY sanctioned path for hot-swapping the production binary.
steps: Run from repo root: bash bin/wktest-promote.sh
Smoke gate is MANDATORY (FORCE=1 to bypass, not recommended).
On success: wkappbot-core.exe + wkappbot-core.new.exe (Eye hot-swap trigger) are updated.
author: claude
